title: First Lessons: Stone
introNarration: Mentor Quern keeps the hearth dummy in sight. Granite takes the cool light and does not complain. The air smells of wet rock after rain and mason's chalk. "Look around this hearth. Weight first. Speech second. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy. Then come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem in your Field Primer."
reminderNarration: Look around this hearth. Defeat the hearth dummy here. Then talk to Quern. He has not hurried the sentence, and he will not drop it.
completionNarration: Quern inks the stem at rank I. Stone-dust from his paw greys the margin. The next lesson will ask you to cast.

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Quern.
